name: US state PFAS product restriction effective dates by category
description: State-by-state PFAS product ban and restriction effective dates. Each record is one state’s ban on one product category, with the effective date, the statute or bill number, the enforcement agency, and any exemptions (e.g. currently unavoidable use). Answers 'can I sell [product] containing PFAS in [state] after [date]', 'which states ban PFAS in cookware', 'when does [state] ban all PFAS products'. Roughly 30 jurisdictions with active or pending PFAS product restrictions as of mid-2026, each with different product category definitions and phase-in schedules.

records.source_quote: After January first, two thousand twenty-five, no person shall sell or offer for sale in this state any new, not previously used, apparel containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances as intentionally added chemicals.
New laws also address PFAS firefighting equipment regulations, with states like New York and Rhode Island prohibiting the sale of firefighting PPE containing intentionally added PFAS.

records.source_quote: On or after January first, two thousand twenty-eight, no person shall sell or offer for sale in this state any new, not previously used, outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances: (a) at or above a level that the department shall establish in regulation, or (b) as intentionally added chemicals.
